mapper.select: SELECT id AS tariffId, name AS tariffName, CAST(monthly_price AS SIGNED) AS price, duration_months AS durationMonth, description AS description, use_product_rules AS useProductRules,free_delivery AS freeDelivery,recurring_order_days AS recurringOrderDays FROM tariff_plans WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY monthly_price ASC, id ASC

SELECT id AS tariffId, name AS tariffName, CAST(monthly_price AS SIGNED) AS price, duration_months AS durationMonth, description AS description, use_product_rules AS useProductRules,free_delivery AS freeDelivery,recurring_order_days AS recurringOrderDays FROM tariff_plans WHERE id = #{tariffId} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT b.product_id,b.discount_percent,p.name product_name FROM tariff_product_benefits b JOIN products p ON p.id=b.product_id WHERE b.tariff_id=#{tariffId} ORDER BY p.name
